SELECT COALESCE(
( SELECT price FROM theme WHERE id = #{targetId} AND #{paymentType} = 'THEME' ),
( SELECT common_code.numeric_value FROM common_code WHERE common_code.type = 5 AND common_code.is_active = TRUE AND #{paymentType} = 'SUBSCRIPTION' ORDER BY common_code.sort DESC LIMIT 1 ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO theme_purchase ( member_id, theme_id, payment_id, is_used ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{themeId}, #{paymentId}, FALSE )

INSERT INTO subscription ( member_id, target_id, price_id, status_id, payment_id, started_at, next_billing_at, ended_at ) SELECT #{memberId}, #{targetId}, common_code.id, #{statusId}, #{paymentId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), NULL
FROM common_code WHERE common_code.type = 5 AND common_code.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY common_code.sort DESC LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO payment_refund ( payment_id, cancellation_id, refund_amount, deduction_amount , refund_reason, requested_at, refunded_at ) VALUES ( #{paymentId}, #{cancellationId}, #{refundAmount}, #{deductionAmount}, #{refundReason}, #{requestedAt}, #{refundedAt} )
